title: :Hover show on a markdown link -> markdown.nvim finds the target -> the file, previewed in place
:Hover show on a bare path in prose -> resolved next to the buffer -> previewed the same way
:Hover show on file.md#heading -> that section of the file, not its top
:Hover show on https://stefanbartl.github.io/wkd/ -> curl fetches the page -> status, title, first words
